description: Closure-effectiveness ledger for corrective-action records. The core runner opens a CAR per failed scope into TestResults/car (ephemeral, gitignored); this file records the subset that was closed WITH EVIDENCE that the fix worked, never the promise that it did. Empty as of 2026-11-16: this repository auto-generates CARs on gate failures (see Run-CoreTests.ps1 Open-VerificationCARs) but no committed record has yet been closed with verified post-fix evidence, and zero records is a true statement. Required fields per record: id, openedAt, closedAt, status (Resolved|Open), severity (SEV1-SEV4), scope, escaped (bool), rootCause, fixCommit, verifiedRunIds (executions green after the fix), verifiedConsecutiveGreen (int), mttrMinutes (== closedAt - openedAt), summary. A Resolved record closes only when at least 2 consecutive executions of the affected scope stayed green after the fix. This ledger is NOT an escape-rate or availability SLO; no production incident data exists for consumers of this tool, and no SLO target is set here beyond the objective-derived internal SLO in Tests/process-baseline.json .slo (see Docs/Escape-Rate-SLO.md).
